content:
Alex: Quick CI check before we tag 0.14.0 — I'm planning to bump the version and freeze branches at 18:00 UTC. Can folks run the smoke dashboard and call out any flaky failures?

Priya: On it. Which branches should we validate? main + release branch?

Alex: main, release/0.14, and feature/serde-fixes please. Also double-check changelog entries (PR #4323).

CI Bot: [ci/smoke] queued -> running on release/0.14 (runner: linux-xlarge)

Marta: hitting a timeout on integration::storage::large_object in the smoke run. log snippet:
```
FAILED test_integration::storage::large_object
thread 'test_integration::storage::large_object' panicked at 'timeout after 300s', tests/common/storage.rs:214:13
```

Jules: I'll triage that test. Looks like a known timing flake when the fixture GC kicks in. Might be noisy under concurrency.

Sam: small reminder — did we include the dependency bump in CHANGELOG? I thought there was a note but can't find it in the draft.

Alex: I added a line under "Notable changes" in #4323 — pinged the PR for review.

Priya: CI shows some Windows runs failing too (different tests). Might be unrelated flakes. Can we rerun the pipeline with a flaky retry policy?

Jules: I'll mark the storage test as flaky in the harness and push a short fix to reduce GC pressure. Re-run command I use locally:
```
CI_FLAKY_RETRY=2 ./scripts/ci/smoke.sh --parallel=3
```

Infra Bot: Increasing concurrent runners for smoke pipelines (+4 linux-xlarge) — should be live in ~30s.

QA: Observed similar storage flake on Windows-2019 VMs yesterday, but less frequent. Might be infra noise. Logging the correlation to flaky-dashboard.

Marta: After rerun, I see the same storage test fail once, then pass on retry. Capture: `timeout` -> pass on retry.

Jules: Pushed a tiny deterministic wait and reduced fixture teardown concurrency: PR #4330. Also added a flaky annotation to the integration test so it doesn't block green gating while we stabilize.

CI Bot: [ci/smoke] re-run triggered by @Jules for release/0.14 -> running

CI Bot: [ci/smoke] release/0.14 -> SUCCESS (all smoke jobs passed) :white_check_mark:

Alex: Nice work, everyone. Changelog PR linked, version bump ready. I think we can keep the freeze schedule but shift to 19:00 UTC to give pilot teams extra time. If no more surprises, I'll tag and upload artifacts at 19:00. :shipit:

Priya: +1 from me. Thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:

Sam: I'm good — will prep the release notes and QA checklist.

Jules: added a short note in the changelog about the flaky test being annotated and opened a follow-up to fully stabilize it.

Alex: Closing loop — will post final tag and release notes in this thread when done. If anything else pops up, ping @alex or @priya.

CI Bot: Automated note: release/0.14 smoke dashboard run completed at 1773460395. Details: https://ci.example.com/runs/98765

Alex: Thanks all!
